resources.string: Records the payments your bank\'s app announces, into the account you choose for it.
Cents reads the notifications of the apps chosen below and records each payment or income without a category, waiting under To categorize. Nothing leaves the phone.
Android lets Cents read notifications. It can be taken back from the same system screen.
Android has to let Cents read notifications before anything is recorded. Turn Cents on in that list, then come back.

Each app has its own account and its own words. A notification from it with an income word is an income, one with an expense word is an expense; with neither, or with no amount, it is ignored. The same amount twice within a minute is recorded once.
Its account is gone, so nothing is recorded
A notification with an income word is an income, and one with an expense word is an expense. With neither, or with no amount, it is ignored.
Only apps with an icon on the home screen are listed. Apps already chosen are not.
Which account do its payments go into?
Tap a word to remove it. Case and accents do not matter, and only whole words match: “cargo” does not match “encargo”.
No words, so nothing is recorded as an expense.
No words, so nothing is recorded as an income.
This list is replaced by the one Cents came with. Words you added are dropped.
A notification with it no longer counts as an expense.
A notification with it no longer counts as an income.
Its payments are no longer recorded. What it already recorded stays in the list.
